source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description:
Gangster

Your life and actions were dictated by one person, your boss. You dis as you were told, completing whatever order you are given, whether it be stealing, or fighting. The lengths you went to achieve the goal didn’t matter, as long as it was completed. But you broke free. Or perhaps you're simply on a quest from the Boss? Do you wish to continue to act as a dog on a leash or live by your own choices and wishes?

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics and Intimidation

Tool Proficiencies: Forgery Kit or Disguise Kit

Equipment: A knife engraved with the symbol of your old gang, commoners clothes, a Decoy.

Equipment Pack: Infiltrator’s Pack or Battlers Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Friend of Mine

You have working relationships throughout the criminal underworld. In most settlements you can locate fences, black market vendors, and criminal contacts capable of providing goods or information unavailable through legitimate channels. When dealing with known criminals or members of organized crime you gain advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks. Work with your GM to establish which organizations are friendly toward you and which are hostile.

Wanted, Dead or Alive

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Strength based Skill Feat)
